summary: Defines two new flags in the IOAM Trace Option headers, the Loopback and Active flags. In situ OAM collects operational and telemetry information in packets as they traverse a path, and these flags add new ways to use it. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: Packets can collect notes about their journey. One new flag asks for a copy to be sent straight back, and another marks a packet as a test one.

questions: what is the ioam loopback flag
what is the ioam active flag
